what: What each company SAID it will spend on its build-out, from its newest earnings call as the vendor holds it. Found by tools/capex_calls.py (a rule), then read by a person: `checked` says how. Only entries marked `use` enter the model.

IREN.quote: For FY '27, we're guiding CapEx of approximately $25 billion to $30 billion.
IREN.financing_quote: Over the past 12 months, we have secured circa $19 billion in funding, nearly $16 billion across customer prepayments, GPU financing and convertible notes alongside equity of approximately $3 billion. The vast majority of this funding is either in cash or yet to be drawn down.
IREN.note: An analyst on the call put what is in hand at "the $14 billion of cash, GPU prepayments and other debt financing". The company: actual spending "will depend on ... the overall fundraising environment".

NBIS.quote: We continue to expect annualized run rate revenue of $7 billion to $9 billion, group revenue of between $3 billion and $3.4 billion, group adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 40%, and capital expenditures of $20 billion to $25 billion.

CRWV.quote: As a result of our increased expectations around capacity to be delivered to customers this year as well as some of our significant recent wins, we now expect 2026 CapEx in the range of $35 billion to $39 billion.

RIVN.quote: Finally, for 2026, we are reducing our capital expenditure guidance by $250 million at the midpoint to $1.7 billion-$1.8 billion, benefiting from project efficiencies and timing of spend.

PL.quote: We are planning for approximately $100 million to $115 million in capital expenditures for the year, reflecting the necessary investments in our manufacturing facilities and next-generation satellites to meet surging market demand.

SERV.quote: We've reduced planned 2026 capital expenditures from about $25 million down to approximately $15 million to $17 million.

AUR.quote: This includes approximately $150 million in anticipated full year capital expenditures, primarily attributed to our capacity plan.

BKSY.quote: Specifically, we expect revenue between $130 million and $150 million, adjusted EBITDA between $12 million and $24 million, and capital expenditures between $50 million and $60 million.

ASTS.period: one quarter guided ($350–425 million for the third quarter of 2026), taken four times over
ASTS.quote: Consistent with average quarterly CapEx spend during the first half of 2026, we expect our capital expenditures in Q3 of 2026 to be in the range of approximately $350 million to $425 million primarily driven by the timing of launch payments.

CORZ.quote: We expect to deploy roughly $2 billion of total capital expenditures in 2026.
CORZ.note: The vendor's newest call for Core Scientific is from May.

QS.quote: For full year 2026, we lowered our guidance for CapEx to be between $27 million and $37 million reflecting capital discipline and cost savings on specific capital projects.

WULF.quote: Approximately $2.3 billion of project capital expenditures have been completed with approximately $1.7 billion remaining.
WULF.note: What is left on named projects, not a figure for the year: shown, not used.

BTDR.quote: In terms of guidance, we are revising our full year crypto mining infrastructure capital expenditures to $200 million to $280 million, driven by additional infrastructure development opportunities we see in North America.
BTDR.note: Covers its mining sites only, not its AI sites: shown, not used.

SPCX.quote: Total company capital expenditures in the second quarter were approximately $18.4 billion, of which roughly $15.8 billion supported AI compute infrastructure.
SPCX.note: What was spent, not a figure for the year ahead: shown, not used.
